event_name: Date 16 August 2020 Time 17:15 2020 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 13 - 16 August 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged forcing another driver of the track
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV Article 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the on-board video from both cars as well as CCTV cameras and concluded that Giovinazzi had substantially completed the overtake on the inside at Turn 1 and had the right to the line. Grosjean avoided a collision by going off track and correctly followed the Race Director's instructions rejoining at Turn 3. Neither driver was predominantly at fault.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 99 Allegedly Forcing Another Driver Off The Track At Turn 2
